_comment: Release notes shown in Settings > Version (TEN-193). Add the new release here at each tag, the same text as the GitHub release (see docs/ci.md, Release signée sur tag). Order does not matter, the app sorts by version.

releases.title: Faster replies, fewer stray tools
releases.intro: With thinking on, a simple question no longer makes you wait a minute, and chats with tools reply faster. Stories, poems and songs are written straight away instead of setting off searches.

groups.label: Faster
items: With thinking on, a simple question gets a short think and a real problem a long one: a one-line answer now comes in seconds instead of about a minute
Chats with tools write their replies faster on the phone's processor
After a reply that used no tool, such as a haiku, the next question no longer waits about two minutes for its first word, even after closing and reopening the app

groups.label: Writing
items: Asking for a story, poem, essay, song, rap or dialogue at the start of a chat, in English or French, gets it written directly, with no search or tool card
After two tool steps in a row fail or are refused, tensai answers with what it has instead of trying more tools

groups.label: Instructions
items: Settings > Instructions lets you write instructions that apply to every chat; each chat can also have its own in its settings
Each chat now starts with a short built-in guide for the model, so an existing chat takes a little longer on its first message after the update

groups.label: Time
items: Asking the time in another city, like Tokyo, gives that city's time instead of the phone's
Asking the time here no longer fails when the model guesses the time zone wrong

groups.label: Chats
items: Swipe a chat left to delete it, with Undo for a few seconds

groups.label: Fixed
items: A model import cut short no longer leaves a hidden file taking up storage; it is cleaned up at the next start
Switching between chats quickly or leaving the app can no longer mix up what the model remembers of each one

groups.label: Privacy
items: Engine error messages no longer include your prompt or the reply text

releases.title: Web pages can no longer act behind your back
releases.intro: A web page tensai reads could try to make it send your data somewhere or plant a memory. Both now stop at a card you answer. Stop also works every time, even in a chat you left and came back to.

groups.label: Web
items: Reading a page you named or a link a search returned works as before; any other address shows a card with the site and the full address first
So text from a page cannot quietly send your clipboard, contacts or notes to another site

groups.label: Memory
items: Once a chat has read a web page, Wikipedia, your calendar, the clipboard or past chats, remembering a new fact asks first and shows the fact exactly as it will be stored
Asking tensai to remember something in a chat that read none of these works without a card

groups.label: Privacy
items: The engine no longer writes the prompt to the system log

groups.label: Stop
items: Tapping Stop right after Send now always stops the reply, instead of letting it run on unseen and keep the model busy
Leaving a chat while a tool runs and coming back shows Stop again; other chats wait for that reply instead of starting one that would collide with it
Stop in the notification ends the whole reply, tool steps included
A reply cut by an engine error is shown as failed instead of as a finished answer
Stop during the first instant of a reply no longer leaves the model's memory of the chat slightly off

groups.label: Tools
items: When the model writes a tool call as raw text, tensai now runs the tool instead of showing the code as its answer

releases.title: Clearer confirmations, cleaner maths
releases.intro: Asking tensai to forget something now shows exactly which fact goes, and products like 17*23 no longer turn a reply into italics.

groups.label: Memory
items: The card that asks before forgetting a fact shows the fact itself, not its number; a long fact is shown in full under the title
If the fact changed or disappeared between the card and your answer, nothing is deleted

groups.label: Fixed
items: An asterisk between numbers, as in 17*23=391, stays an asterisk instead of turning the text around it into italics, in replies and in the reasoning block

releases.title: New app id, instant first message
releases.intro: tensai now installs as io.github.tensaiapp, and a new chat no longer waits for the model to read its tool list: the first message starts in seconds.

groups.label: New app id
items: This version installs as a new app, next to the previous one: Android treats a new id as a different app, so it cannot update it in place
Models and conversations stay in the previous app: import or download your models again here, then uninstall the old app when you no longer need it

groups.label: Faster
items: Right after a model loads, tensai reads the system prompt and the tool list in the background, so the first message of a chat starts in about 1 s instead of more than a minute (Qwen3-1.7B on a Dimensity 900, CPU)

Opening a new chat after changing the tools in Settings prepares the new tool list before you type, after saving the previous conversation: first message in about 4 s, and the previous conversation comes back intact

groups.label: Under the hood
items: Vulkan can split large matrix products into shorter GPU jobs to keep the interface smooth while a prompt is read; off by default while it is measured on more phones

releases.title: Faster follow-ups
releases.intro: Follow-up messages no longer pay again for the whole previous answer, Auto picks the faster backend for more models, and Vulkan loads keep the phone usable while they read a prompt.

groups.label: Faster
items: A new message reuses the cached previous answer instead of reading it again: after a 700-token reply, the next message starts in about 5 s instead of about 50 (Qwen3-1.7B on a Dimensity 900)
Auto now runs models of an unknown architecture on the CPU, which was faster everywhere it was measured on this class of phone (TwIL-LM3: prompt 14 tok/s on CPU against 3.9 on Vulkan)

groups.label: Vulkan
items: Models that run on Vulkan read the prompt in smaller batches and on a low priority GPU queue: about 20% faster, and the interface no longer freezes for up to a second while the GPU works (it still runs below full frame rate)

groups.label: Under the hood
items: Two tests that failed now and then in CI are deterministic

releases.title: Permissions + Network
releases.intro: The model can now read your calendar and your approximate location, and, if you turn it on, look things up on the web. The Internet tier is off by default: with it off, nothing leaves the phone.

groups.label: Web (Settings > Tools > Internet, off by default)
items: Web search: DuckDuckGo, with Wikipedia and Marginalia as fallbacks, no key needed. Optional Tavily key (1,000 free searches a month, no card) or Brave key (monthly free credit, card required) in Settings, with a Test button
Read a web page: the model fetches a link and reads its text. HTTPS only, local and private addresses are blocked
Weather from Open-Meteo: today, tomorrow, a weekday or a date, for a city or "here"
Wikipedia summaries
Every network call shows where it went and what was sent: "Sent to DuckDuckGo · <query>"

groups.label: Phone, with Android permission at first use
items: Calendar: "what is on my calendar today?", a day or a range up to 31 days. Only titles, times and places reach the model
Location: approximate only (about 1 km), never precise GPS. tensai does not turn it into an address
Revoking a permission while the model uses it gives a clear refusal with a link to the app settings

groups.label: App
items: What's new: tap the version in Settings
Settings > Storage shows the real free space, with a colored legend (models, other data, free)

releases.title: Tooling
releases.intro: The model can now use tools: it checks things on the phone, acts through your apps, remembers what you tell it, and asks when your request is ambiguous. Everything still runs on the phone.

groups.label: Tools
items: On this phone: date and time, calculator, unit and time zone conversion, device info (battery, storage, RAM), search past chats, memory, clipboard, torch

Phone actions through your apps: timer, alarm, calendar event, SMS and email drafts (to a number or a contact name), open an app or a link, media control. Nothing is sent by tensai: the target app opens and you confirm there
Contacts: drafts accept a name ("Jade"); with several matches the model asks you which one. Android's contacts permission is asked at first use
Questions: the model can ask a single or multiple choice question; the card replaces the input bar
Memory: facts you ask it to remember are added to every conversation; manage or turn them off in Settings > Memory

groups.label: In the chat
items: Tool calls show as a discreet line between the reasoning and the answer; tap it for the timeline and each call's inputs and output
Calls that delete something or open a link ask first (Allow / Deny)
Settings > Tools: turn each tier on or off
Context sheet: tool definitions, tool results and memory in the breakdown, and an Agent activity section (calls, tokens, time per tool)
Copy a message: long press, or the copy button under replies

groups.label: Faster
items: The fixed part of the prompt (system and tool definitions) is cached on disk: the first tool turn after loading a model went from ~4 min to ~10 s
CPU models no longer send the prefill to the GPU: prompt processing ~4x faster, generation ~1.7x faster on a Dimensity 900
The UI no longer stutters while a prompt is processed
The reasoning of the current turn is kept between a tool call and its result, so the model continues instead of starting over

releases.title: Models
releases.intro: Models from Hugging Face, a context view, and a simpler navigation.

groups.label: Models
items: Discover: search Hugging Face, filters (fits my phone, tools), models recommended for your device
Repo page with every quant, its size and whether it fits; download with pause/resume, sha256 check, progress notification, mobile data and free space checks
Gated models with a Hugging Face token
Model picker from the chip in the input bar
Chat template fallback for GGUFs that ship without one
Files this build can't run (unknown architecture, draft heads) are flagged and can't be loaded
Per-architecture backend choice extended (lfm2 on CPU, nemotron_h on Vulkan)

groups.label: Chat
items: Context ring in the top bar and a Context sheet: token breakdown, runtime details
The app opens on a new chat; the old Home screen is its empty state
Chats page: search, grouped by date, multi-select delete
Input bar capped at 10 lines, scrolling past it

groups.label: Navigation
items: One conversation at the root; Models, Settings and Chats open on top and back returns to it
Drawer scrolls as one list, recents capped at 20 with "All chats"

releases.intro: First release: run a GGUF model fully on your phone and chat with it. Nothing leaves the device.

groups.label: Models
items: Import a GGUF file from this phone
llama.cpp engine on CPU and Vulkan, backend picked per architecture
Session cache: a conversation you reopen resumes without re-reading its history

groups.label: Chat
items: Markdown replies with code blocks, and the model's reasoning in a collapsible block
Per-conversation settings: instructions, thinking on or off, sampling presets, max response length
Onboarding on first launch, Home screen, empty and error states

groups.label: App
items: Settings: theme, language (English and French), backend, context length, KV cache type
Signed release APK built by CI
